name: Minazuki Kazuha
source: A maid working for the Kisaragi family. Kazuha likes to read manga and play games, especially TCG, but she cannot discuss it with someone else, since the Kisaragi family doesn't talk too much. She wants to know what happened to her parents and the truth of the fire incident, which happened in the past at the house of her family.
